text:
maria: Quick Q — where are the dashboards for GPU SM% / GPU memory / KV-cache hit rate / batch size distribution? Investigating a Dedicated pool with increased tail latency. Also wondering if we have recommended alert thresholds for SM skew or KV miss rate. cc @lee @anjali

lee: Grafana panels live in the inference cluster folder. Start here: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference/gpu-overview. Panels to check: `GPU SM% (per-GPU)`, `GPU memory used`, `KV cache hit ratio`, `batch size histogram (last 1h)`.

lee: Quick queries you can paste into Explore: 
```
avg by (gpu)(rate(gpu_sm_utilization[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_ratio[5m])
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

anjali: For alerts we typically use these starters (tweak for pool size):
- SM saturation: `avg(gpu_sm_utilization) > 85% for 5m` -> scale up or route to cheaper model variant.
- SM underutilized/skew: `p95(gpu_sm_utilization) - p05(gpu_sm_utilization) > 50% for 10m` -> indicates hot-spotting/scheduling issues.
- KV cache miss: `kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.10 for 10m` -> investigate cache sizing / prefix churn.
- Batch tail: `histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) < 2` for large-model pools -> flag degenerate batching.

sam: Also add these traces/logs: Loki link for logs with GPU driver tags: https://loki.redwood.ai/streams?query=%7Bcomponent=%22inference%22%2Cgpu%3D%22*%22%7D and traces for slow tail: https://traces.redwood.ai/search?service=inference-runtime.

sam: If you're looking at a specific machine, append `instance= i-xxxx` in Grafana to narrow down. For kvcache we have per-model namespace so check `kv_namespace` tag.

maria: Thanks — that Grafana link is exactly it. Quick follow-up: who owns the alert config for Dedicated pools? I don't want to accidentally change prod alerts.

lee: Ownership is eng-runtime on-call team. File a PR against `infra/alerts/inference/` repo or ping `#eng-oncall` with the proposed rule. We can add lower-severity alerts to a `warning` channel first.

anjali: If you want, paste the exact metrics you saw and I can suggest tuned thresholds for that pool size. Also tag the pool id so infra folks can look at autoscaler logs.

infra-bot: New dashboard sync completed (run id: d3f9a). If there are missing panels, file a dashboard issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-dashboards/issues/new

maria: Will do. Sharing p95/gpu_sm and kv miss numbers in a follow-up. Thanks all :raised_hands:
